name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Add remote server connections as encrypted SSH deployment profiles, then publish local projects with confirmation-gated deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Add remote server connections and deploy local projects.
interface.longDescription: Opens an embedded profile editor with a native private-key path picker, saves named SSH deployment profiles in the current user's OS credential protection, then packages and uploads the current project with OpenSSH and runs an explicit command only after a hashed dry run and confirmation. Private key contents are never accepted, read, or uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Add a remote server connection and open its secure editor.
Deploy this local site using my saved production profile.
List my saved SSH deployment profiles.
